SELECT id, eqp_code eqpCode, eqp_name eqpName, assets_code assetsCode, eqp_type_id eqpTypeId, enable_flag enableFlag
FROM EPM_EQP WHERE eqp_code = #{identifier} OR assets_code = #{identifier}

SELECT t.id, eqp_code , eqp_name , eqp_type_id, CASE t.LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 'LINE' THEN CASE WHEN area.AREA_NAME IS NULL THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(fab.FAB_NAME,'-'),line.LINE_NAME) ELSE CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(fab.FAB_NAME,'-'),area.AREA_NAME),'-'),line.LINE_NAME) END
ELSE '' END AS location FROM EPM_EQP t left join epm_eqp_type e on t.EQP_TYPE_ID = e.ID left join mdm_fac_fab fab on t.LOCATION_FIRST_ID = fab.ID left join mdm_fac_area area on t.LOCATION_SECOND_ID = area.ID left join mdm_fac_line line on t.LOCATION_THIRD_ID = line.ID WHERE (eqp_code LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR (eqp_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
